title: Buckit
tagline: AI based Influencer-Inspired Decentralised Travel - Travel to Earn
description:
This is an influencer inspired travel platform. Users can link their video content and earn rewards and travelers can get inspirations of activities and add it to their bucketlist. Travel agencies can quote them offers, with token incentives.
Also users can follow each other and see their combined buckets, which will be helpful in trip itinerary planning.
how_its_made:
I have used 

Dynamic for managing social auth and session.

I have used Hedera Services 
- HTS to create BCK token to incentivize content creation as well as NFT minting for issuing badges.
- I have used HFS for file services for the platform content
- I have also improvised Smart Contract for bucketlist curation as well as for following users.
- I have used HCS Topic Creation for Notifying users for activities like following request or bucketlist addition. Also same will be used to get analytics for travel partners.

I have used ENS also to create subdomains as registrar for Travel partners and deployed its smart contract to Sepolia Testnet.
